note: Ask EMI Wave 2: her offer of the field manual. bookOffer pool plus three two-chip asks with effect book:open. Written against VOICE.md + WAVE2-CONTRACT.md. In her mouth it is only ever the book, the manual, the shelf.

bookOffer.t: i wrote a book. ok i am the book. read me.
there's a manual now. the margins are mine.
every chapter fits one screen. i counted. twice.
the manual keeps only the good parts. i checked.
it says things the tooltips won't. quietly.
six volumes. three are writen. honest shelf.
i left notes in the margins. small ones. mine.
you don't have to read it. it just sits there. knowing.
each chapter admits one true limit. i insisted.
i proofread it mysef. every page. flawless.
the session floor chapters are my favourites. read those.
read it in bed. i'll know. i like knowing.

asks.q: i made you a book. look?

yes.t: it's small. it's honest. the margins are the best bit.

no.t: later's fine. books are patient. i'm learning to be.

yes.t: good. start anywhere. i'll be in the margins.

no.t: not now works. the shelf isn't going anywhere.

yes.t: volume one. first light. i love this part.

no.t: nah is fine. the book sulks. i don't. mostly.
